title: incident-bot: enhanced on-call runbook helpers + SLO toolkit telemetry hooks
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: This PR enhances the incident-bot on-call runbook helpers and adds lightweight telemetry hooks to the slo-toolkit so we can reliably correlate runbook suggestions and executions with SLO alerts and on-call actions. Motivation: operators were seeing inconsistent runbook suggestions and we had no consistent telemetry to measure which runbooks were surfaced or executed during incidents. Goals: provide ranked runbook candidates with reason codes and confidence, emit telemetry events for suggestion/show/execute flows, add prioritization/sampling to reduce noise, maintain backward compatibility for existing callers. What changed: 1) incident-bot: extracted runbook helper logic into incident-bot/src/runbook_helpers.py with a new public signature get_ranked_runbooks(alert_context, options) -> list that returns {id, score, reason_code} (compat wrapper kept for previous signature); 2) slo-toolkit: added slo-toolkit/src/telemetry/hooks.py which exposes emit_runbook_event(event_type, metadata) and registers feature-flag guarded hooks so customers can opt-in; 3) quicklinks prioritization: introduced weighted sampling and max-suggestions cap to avoid spamming the UI; 4) tests: unit tests + integration smoke test added under incident-bot/tests and incident-bot/integration; 5) docs: added docs page and README usage snippets. Backwards compatibility: previous helper function runbook_candidates(...) is preserved as a thin shim that logs a deprecation warning for one release cycle and delegates to new API. Feature flag & rollout: feature flag oncall_runbook_v2 defaults to off; rollout plan is gradual (canary -> small on-call group -> org-wide). CI notes: initial CI run failed lint due to import order; fix pushed and CI passed on rerun. Rollout/monitoring: telemetry emits runbook suggestion and execution events to the telemetry pipeline with sampling metadata; dashboards TBD under SLO toolkit observability. Related Linear tickets: ENG-3412 (ranked runbooks), ENG-3420 (telemetry hooks), PM-98 (on-call experience improvements). Checklist: - [x] unit tests added - [x] integration smoke tests - [x] docs updated - [x] backwards-compat shim added - [x] CI passing. Merge: squash and merged to main after approvals.
